forum-shot.card-table.reason-cannot-judg.text: Its settings could not be checked for outside addresses.

forum-shot.card-table.reason-custom-card.text: It holds another card (a custom-card module) that nothing here can check.

forum-shot.card-table.reason-limit.text: It names more outside websites than a forum shot allows.

forum-shot.card-table.reason-outside-add.text: It loads something from outside Home Assistant.

forum-shot.element.admin-only.text: Only the default dashboard is listed, because listing the others needs an administrator account.

forum-shot.element.config-read-failed.text: Your dashboards could not be read. Check that they are not YAML dashboards, then try again.

forum-shot.element.custom-card.text: This card holds another card inside it (a custom-card module). That card can load pictures from outside Home Assistant and nothing here can check it, so this card cannot be used for a forum shot.

forum-shot.element.error-capture-failed.text: The picture could not be made in this browser. Try again, or use another browser.

forum-shot.element.error-card-not-define.text: The Magic Card is not loaded in this browser tab. Reload the page and try again.

forum-shot.element.error-font-unavailabl.text: A font could not be loaded, so no picture was made. Check your connection and try again.

forum-shot.element.error-hosts-changed.text: The fonts this card asks for changed since the list was made, and nothing was fetched. The list is up to date now. Check the sites it names, then press Download again.

forum-shot.element.error-too-large.text: The picture would be too large. Choose light or dark only, or turn off the three looks.

forum-shot.element.font-host-contact.text: To draw the fonts, your browser asks {hosts} for them. Those sites can see your IP address, the time of the request, which fonts you ask for and the ordinary details every browser sends, such as its type and language. Your cards and settings are not sent.

forum-shot.element.intro.text: Pick one of your Magic Cards and save it as a picture to post in a forum.

forum-shot.element.local-only.text: The picture is made in your browser. Nothing leaves Home Assistant, and Magic Card does not keep a copy.

forum-shot.element.local-only-font.text: The picture is made in your browser, and Magic Card does not keep a copy. Your cards and settings stay in Home Assistant, but the fonts are fetched from the sites named here.

forum-shot.element.looks.text: Show the Quiet, Living and Glow looks of animated icons, one row each

forum-shot.element.no-cards.text: No Magic Cards were found on your dashboards.

forum-shot.element.notice-remote-placeho.text: A picture from outside Home Assistant was replaced by a placeholder, so no other server was contacted. Your card may look different on your dashboard.
A picture from outside Home Assistant was replaced by a placeholder, and no server was asked for it. Your card may look different on your dashboard.

forum-shot.element.preview-alt.text: Preview of the forum shot picture

forum-shot.element.privacy-hint.text: Check the picture before you post it. A card can show names, places, camera images and the state of your devices, and everyone who sees your post can see them too.

forum-shot.element.remote-asset.text: This card loads an image, a web address or another file from outside Home Assistant that cannot be checked. It cannot be used for a forum shot, because making the picture would contact an unchecked server.

forum-shot.element.saved.text: The picture was saved to your downloads.
